steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: The Solar System consists of the Sun and everything gravitationally bound to it | Key Fact: Eight planets orbit the Sun: four terrestrial (Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars) and four gas/ice giants (Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune) | Key Fact: Dwarf planets include Pluto, Ceres, Eris, Haumea and Makemake | Key Fact: The asteroid belt lies between Mars and Jupiter

steps.title: Homework & Consolidation
steps.body: Consolidation, retrieval on key terms from the solar system overview, and one past-paper question.
